ladder.label: UPTREND
ladder.why: The weekly (investor-cycle) momentum just crossed UP while price holds its 10-day average — the start of a new multi-month up-leg. A daily-overbought print here is the launch thrust, not a top, so this is a HOLD / ride, not a take-profit. The daily can still dip to its 10-day average (normal) — but the bigger investor cycle is early, with room left. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Hold / ride the fresh weekly up-leg; add on pullbacks toward the 10-day average rather than chasing the thrust. First warning would be the weekly momentum rolling back over.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BULLISH — weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 6 · daily cycle day 18).
ladder.synthesis_line: Daily is hot (RSI 77, day 18/42 — a dip is normal soon), but the weekly investor cycle just turned up — so this is HOLD / ride a new up-leg, not take-profits.
ladder.synthesis_line_zh: 日线偏热（RSI 77，周期第 18 天——短期回调属正常），但周线投资者周期刚刚向上转向——因此应持有 / 顺势新上行段，而非止盈。
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 18 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 18 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 6 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: early — lots of room left in the bigger up-leg
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 6 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 早期——更大的上行段仍有充足空间
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 周线（投资者周期）动量刚刚向上交叉，且价格守住 10 日均线——这是新的多月上行段的起点。此处日线超买只是启动推力、并非见顶，因此应持有 / 顺势，而非止盈。日线仍可能回踩 10 日均线（属正常）——但更大的投资者周期尚处早期，仍有空间。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 持有 / 顺应新的周线上行段；在回踩 10 日均线时加仓，而非追高推力。首个预警将是周线动量重新掉头向下。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看多 — 周线动量刚刚向上交叉；3 日线向上交叉；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 6 周 · 日线周期第 18 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（顺势）：看多。
points_zh: 大局为看多（对日线多头而言属顺势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal just triggered today (fresh cross from NEARING A HIGH). Signal strength: moderate (score +45/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自接近高点翻转）。 信号强度：中等（评分 +45/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱买入形态（+31）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。
